Since digitoxin is significantly metabo- lised in the liver it may be affected by drugs that induce micro- somal enzymes, including rifampicin (see below) and antiepilep- tics such as phenobarbital. Acute heart failure has been reported in a pa- tient taking digitoxin when treatment with rifampicin and isoni- azid was started; plasma-digitoxin concentrations fell from a pre- treatment steady-state value of 27 nanograms/mL to 10 nanograms/mL.
